words.enDefinition: revenue arising from marginal production

examples.en: Late-season wells still add marginal production revenue without new drilling.
examples.zh: 临近季末，老油井无需新钻井就能带来「边际生产收益」。

examples.en: Accountants split marginal production revenue from base output in the report.
examples.zh: 报表中，会计把「边际生产收益」与基础产量收益分开列示。

words.enDefinition: the cost of marginal production operating

examples.en: Topping up from standby wells lifts the marginal production operating cost.
examples.zh: 启用备用井增产会抬高「边际生产作业成本」。

examples.en: We shut the platform when oil dips below the marginal production operating cost.
examples.zh: 油价跌破「边际生产作业成本」时，我们就关停平台。

allocate the marginal production operating cost
cut the marginal production operating cost

words.enDefinition: management of manufacturing

examples.en: She moved from shop-floor supervision into manufacturing management last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，她从车间监督岗转入了「生产管理」岗位。

examples.en: Good manufacturing management keeps both quality and delivery dates intact.
examples.zh: 出色的「生产管理」能同时守住质量和交期。

words.enDefinition: a firm whose main activity is manufacturing goods

examples.en: Every manufacturing firm in the park faces the same energy surcharge.
examples.zh: 园区里每家「制造企业」都面临同样的能源附加费。

examples.en: The bank lends to a manufacturing firm only after visiting the plant.
examples.zh: 银行只有在实地考察工厂后，才向「制造企业」放贷。

collocations: open an account at the manufacturing firm

words.enDefinition: a process used for manufacturing expenses in

examples.en: Half-built chairs carry manufacturing expenses in process on the WIP ledger.
examples.zh: 半成品座椅在账上挂有「在制品的制造费用」。

examples.en: Closing the month rolls manufacturing expenses in process into finished goods.
examples.zh: 月末结账时，「在制品制造费用」会结转进产成品。

collocations: prioritise the manufacturing expenses in process
standardise the manufacturing expenses in process
monitor the manufacturing expenses in process

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual manufacturing expense

examples.en: A negative manufacturing expense variance traced back to cheaper solvents.
examples.zh: 「制造费用差异」的不利结果最终追溯到较贵的溶剂。

examples.en: The plant reviews every manufacturing expense variance at Monday's meeting.
examples.zh: 工厂在周一例会上逐项审查「制造费用差异」。

words.enDefinition: an order related to manufacturing expense

examples.en: Maintenance draws supplies only against a signed manufacturing expense order.
examples.zh: 维修领料必须凭已签批的「制造费用通知单」。

examples.en: Each manufacturing expense order names the department that will pay.
examples.zh: 每张「制造费用通知单」都注明由哪个部门承担。

words.enDefinition: a margin of profit used in professional practice

examples.en: Even with rising freight, our margin of profit held above twelve percent.
examples.zh: 即使运费上涨，我们的「利润率」仍保持在百分之十二以上。

examples.en: The margin of profit on services beats hardware every year.
examples.zh: 服务业务的「利润率」年年都高于硬件。

words.enDefinition: the cost of manufacturing activity

examples.en: Tooling changes pushed our manufacturing cost above the tender estimate.
examples.zh: 工装变更使「制造成本」超出了投标估算。

examples.en: Share the manufacturing cost breakdown with the client before signing.
examples.zh: 签约前，把「制造成本」明细分享给客户。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for manufacturing

examples.en: The consultant completely rebuilt our manufacturing costing model around machine-hours.
examples.zh: 顾问以机器工时为核心重构了我们的「制造成本计算」。

examples.en: Accurate manufacturing costing exposed the real loss on custom orders.
examples.zh: 准确的「制造成本计算」暴露了定制订单的亏损。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing costs grouped by class or category

examples.en: The filing shows manufacturing costs classified by department and by behaviour.
examples.zh: 档案按部门和成本习性对「制造成本」作了分类。

examples.en: Auditors expect the manufacturing costs classified consistently, year after year.
examples.zh: 审计人员期望「制造成本分类」逐年保持一致。

words.enDefinition: a process used for manufacturing expense in

examples.en: Unfinished harnesses still hold manufacturing expense in process at month end.
examples.zh: 月末时，未完工线束仍挂有「在制品的制造费用」。

examples.en: We estimate manufacturing expense in process from standard hours applied.
examples.zh: 我们按已耗标准工时估算「在制品制造费用」。

collocations: prioritise the manufacturing expense in process
standardise the manufacturing expense in process
monitor the manufacturing expense in process

words.enDefinition: distribution of manufacturing expense

examples.en: Floor space drives our manufacturing expense distribution across all lines.
examples.zh: 我们的「制造费用分配」以占地面积为基准。

examples.en: The worksheet documents every manufacturing expense distribution key we used.
examples.zh: 表格记录了所使用的「制造费用分配」标准。

words.enDefinition: statistics on manufacturing

examples.en: Weekly manufacturing statistics now post to the plant dashboard automatically.
examples.zh: 每周「生产统计」现在会自动更新到看板上。

examples.en: Economists read these manufacturing statistics as an early demand signal.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「生产统计」视作需求的先行信号。

words.enDefinition: margin money and related guarantees

examples.en: The broker holds margin and guaranty before accepting the position.
examples.zh: 经纪商在接受头寸前先收存「保证金」。

examples.en: Rules require margin and guaranty to sit in a segregated account.
examples.zh: 规则要求「保证金」存放于独立账户。

words.enDefinition: rates applied to manufacturing overhead

examples.en: We reset manufacturing overhead rates each October from budgeted hours.
examples.zh: 每年十月，我们按预算工时重定「制造费用分配率」。

examples.en: Stale manufacturing overhead rates distorted every product line's reported margin.
examples.zh: 过时的「制造费用分配率」扭曲了各产品线的毛利。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual manufacturing overhead spending

examples.en: A positive manufacturing overhead spending variance came from lower power tariffs.
examples.zh: 电价下调带来了「制造费用耗费差异」的有利结果。

examples.en: Supervisors explain the manufacturing overhead spending variance line by line.
examples.zh: 主管们逐项解释「制造费用耗费差异」的成因。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual manufacturing overhead volume

examples.en: Idle moulds produced a heavy manufacturing overhead volume variance in May.
examples.zh: 模具闲置造成了严重的「制造费用产量差异」。

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead volume variance warns that capacity went unused.
examples.zh: 「制造费用产量差异」提示产能未被充分利用。

collocations: prioritise the manufacturing overhead volume variance
standardise the manufacturing overhead volume variance
monitor the manufacturing overhead volume variance

words.enDefinition: the sector of manufacturing

examples.en: The manufacturing sector absorbed most of the region's new hires.
examples.zh: 「制造部门」吸纳了该地区大部分新增就业。

examples.en: Currency swings hit the manufacturing sector before services feel anything.
examples.zh: 汇率波动总是先冲击「制造业」，服务业才后知后觉。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual manufacturing overhead efficiency

examples.en: Skilled operators turned the manufacturing overhead efficiency variance favourable this month.
examples.zh: 熟练工让「制造费用效能差异」转为有利。

examples.en: A lingering manufacturing overhead efficiency variance points to old tooling.
examples.zh: 「制造费用效能差异」迟迟不利，说明工装老化了。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for managed

examples.zh: 展会和赞助属于「酌量性成本」，每季度重新审视。

examples.zh: 经济下行时先砍「酌量性成本」，正式员工保留。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for managed fixed

examples.en: Advertising is one of our managed fixed costs, not a contract.
examples.zh: 广告是我们「酌量性固定成本」之一，并非合同义务。

examples.en: CFOs freeze managed fixed costs before touching the shop floor.
examples.zh: 首席财务官们先冻结「酌量性固定成本」，再考虑动车间。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with inventory

examples.en: Selling off slow inventory assets freed warehouse space for the festive range.
examples.zh: 清掉滞销的「库存资产」，为节日商品腾出了仓库空间。

examples.en: Lenders discount inventory assets heavily when setting the lending facility.
examples.zh: 银行设定授信额度时对「存货资产」大打折扣。

words.enDefinition: an office handling managing export

examples.en: Clearances route through the managing export office in the port district.
examples.zh: 清关手续都要经港区的「出口管理处」办理。

examples.en: The managing export office doubled its approval volume this quarter.
examples.zh: 这家「出口管理局」本季度的审批量翻了一番。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for management and general

examples.en: Audit fees sit in management and general expense, not in projects.
examples.zh: 审计费记在「管理与总务费用」中，不计入项目。

examples.en: Donors watch our management and general expense ratios before giving.
examples.zh: 捐赠人捐款前会关注「管理与总务费用」的占比。

collocations: book the management and general expense
forecast the management and general expense
limit the management and general expense

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage managerial cost

examples.en: Managerial cost control begins with signing off every purchase request.
examples.zh: 「管理成本的控制」从签批每一张请购单开始。

examples.en: Her managerial cost control earned the branch a company award.
examples.zh: 她出色的「管理成本控制」为分店赢得了公司奖项。

words.enDefinition: marketing of managerial

examples.en: Managerial marketing decides which channels deserve next year's ad spend.
examples.zh: 「管理型营销」决定哪些渠道值得投入明年的预算。

examples.en: The evening MBA course pairs managerial marketing with pricing workshops.
examples.zh: 这门MBA课程把「管理营销」与定价工作坊结合起来。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for management

examples.en: Head office pushed management expenses down without cutting field service.
examples.zh: 总部在不削减服务的前提下压降了「管理费用」。

examples.en: Group management expenses must stay under nine percent of turnover.
examples.zh: 「管理费用」必须控制在营业额的百分之九以内。

words.enDefinition: firms that provide management engineering services

examples.en: Management engineering firms redesigned the assembly cell in six weeks.
examples.zh: 「管理工程公司」在六周内重新设计了装配单元。

examples.en: We shortlisted three management engineering firms for the layout study.
examples.zh: 我们筛选了三家「管理工程机构」来做布局研究。

collocations: partner with the management engineering firms
switch to the management engineering firms

words.enDefinition: freedom of managers to make operating decisions

examples.en: The charter grants each subsidiary real management autonomy over pricing.
examples.zh: 章程赋予各子公司在定价上真正的「经营管理自主权」。

examples.en: Staff turnover fell sharply once management autonomy reached team level.
examples.zh: 「经营管理自主权」下放到团队后，人员流失下降了。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with management

examples.en: A separate management company runs all the marina's daily operations.
examples.zh: 一家独立的「管理公司」负责游艇码头的日常运营。

examples.en: Owners chose the management company with the clearest fee schedule.
examples.zh: 业主们选择了收费最透明的这家「管理公司」。

words.enDefinition: consulting for management

examples.en: After the army, he built a career in management consulting.
examples.zh: 退伍后，他在「企业管理咨询」行业干出了一番事业。

examples.en: All management consulting fees come out of the transformation budget.
examples.zh: 「管理咨询」费用从转型预算中列支。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning management

examples.en: The hotel group operates the property under a management contract.
examples.zh: 酒店集团以「管理合同」方式运营这家物业。

examples.en: The management contract runs ten years, with performance bonuses attached.
examples.zh: 这份「管理合同」为期十年，并附带业绩奖金。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage management

examples.en: Daily stand-up meetings are our simplest form of management control.
examples.zh: 每日站会是我们最简单的「经营控制」手段。

examples.en: Tight management control stopped the discounting race between the regions.
examples.zh: 严格的「经营控制」止住了各区域之间的折扣竞赛。

words.enDefinition: a recurring sequence related to management

examples.en: Plan, do, check, act: the management cycle never really ends.
examples.zh: 计划、执行、检查、改进——「企业管理循环」永无止境。

examples.en: Our management cycle resets itself every quarter against fresh targets.
examples.zh: 我们的「管理循环」每季度随新目标重新启动。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for management through

examples.en: Management through costs means every quote carries a standard cost sheet.
examples.zh: 「通过成本进行管理」意味着每份报价都附标准成本单。

examples.en: The factory credits management through costs for its margin recovery.
examples.zh: 工厂把毛利回升归功于「成本管理」方法。

words.enDefinition: the cost of management indirect

examples.en: Finance allocates management indirect cost by each team's occupied square metres.
examples.zh: 财务按占用面积分摊「管理部门间接成本」。

examples.en: Grant rules cap management indirect cost at ten percent of funding.
examples.zh: 资助条款规定「管理部门间接成本」不得超过经费的百分之十。

words.enDefinition: training for management

examples.en: Promotion now requires a completed certificate in formal management training.
examples.zh: 如今晋升需要持有「经营管理培训」证书。

examples.en: The firm pays for management training nights at the local college.
examples.zh: 公司为员工在当地学院的「管理培训」夜校买单。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for management of indirect

examples.zh: 对「间接成本」的精细管理挽救了这份亏损合同。

examples.en: Our dashboard supports management of indirect costs by cost center.
examples.zh: 我们的看板支持按「成本中心」管理间接成本。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to management

examples.en: Group management overheads fell steeply after the shared-services switch last year.
examples.zh: 改用共享服务后，集团「间接管理费用」下降了。

examples.en: Investors keep querying why management overheads grow faster than revenue.
examples.zh: 投资人追问「管理费用」为何增速超过收入。

words.enDefinition: a specialization for management

examples.en: New management specialization split the region into product-led business units.
examples.zh: 「管理专门化」把大区拆成了按产品划分的单元。

examples.en: Critics blame this management specialization for the silo thinking everywhere.
examples.zh: 批评者把部门墙归咎于「管理专业化」分工。

words.enDefinition: a planned approach for management

examples.en: Each reserve submits a management plan for the next five years.
examples.zh: 每个保护区都要提交未来五年的「管理计划」。

examples.en: The management plan clearly names risks, owners, and review dates.
examples.zh: 这份「管理计划」列明了风险、责任人和复查日期。

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing management

examples.en: Our written management policy forbids accepting gifts above fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 我们的「经营方针」禁止收受超过五十美元的礼品。

examples.en: The new management policy pushes decisions to the shop floor.
examples.zh: 新的「经营方针」把决策权下放到车间。

words.enDefinition: performance of management

examples.en: Annual bonuses now track management performance against the balanced scorecard.
examples.zh: 奖金依据平衡计分卡上的「管理业绩」发放。

examples.en: Weak cash conversion dragged the management performance scores down again.
examples.zh: 现金转化乏力拖低了「管理成果」评分。

words.enDefinition: money received from commission

examples.zh: 保险转介带来的「手续费收入」如今已可与收费收入比肩。

examples.zh: 返点规则调整后，那个季度「佣金收入」有所下滑。

words.enDefinition: a fee charged for collecting funds on behalf of a client

examples.zh: 银行对海外支票托收收取「代收款手续费」。

examples.en: A two percent commission for collection covers stamp duty and post.
examples.zh: 百分之二的「代收佣金」涵盖了印花税和邮费。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for commission

examples.en: Commission charges on the trade wiped out most of the spread.
examples.zh: 这笔交易的「佣金」几乎吃光了价差收益。

examples.en: Always compare commission charges across brokers before opening the account.
examples.zh: 开户之前，先比较各经纪商的「佣金」标准。

words.enDefinition: able to be sold in ordinary commercial markets

examples.en: The prototype is finally commercially saleable after the safety fixes.
examples.zh: 经过安全整改，样机终于达到了「可作商业性销售」的标准。

examples.en: Nothing in this batch is commercially saleable until the licence clears.
examples.zh: 在许可办妥之前，这些都不能「作商业性销售」。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with commission

examples.en: A Rotterdam commission agency sells our daily catches at auction.
examples.zh: 鹿特丹的一家「佣金代理行」在拍卖会上销售我们的渔获。

examples.en: The commission agency never at any point takes title to goods.
examples.zh: 这家「佣金代理商」从不取得货物所有权。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing goods in very large quantities

examples.en: Mass production only starts once the pilot line passes audit.
examples.zh: 试产线通过审核后才能开始「大量生产」。

examples.en: Mass production brought our unit costs down by two thirds.
examples.zh: 「大批量生产」使单位成本下降了三分之二。

words.enDefinition: a consignment of commissions earned on

examples.zh: 只有货物实际售出，才确认「代销佣金收入」。

examples.en: The gallery reports all commissions earned on consignment each quarter.
examples.zh: 画廊每季度申报「代销佣金收入」。

collocations: schedule the commissions earned on consignment

words.enDefinition: commissions that has been earned

examples.zh: 十二月赚取的「佣金」付清了团队奖金。

examples.en: Reconcile all commissions earned against the signed deal log weekly.
examples.zh: 把「已赚佣金」与签约台账进行核对。

words.enDefinition: a system for commission

examples.en: Their commission system rewards account renewals, not just new sales.
examples.zh: 他们的「手续费制度」奖励续约，而不只奖励新签单。

examples.en: A fair commission system keeps good agents from drifting away.
examples.zh: 公平的「佣金制度」能留住优秀的代理人。

words.enDefinition: the cost of converting materials into finished goods

examples.en: Cutting scrap rates lowered conversion cost on the bottling line.
examples.zh: 降低废品率使灌装线的「加工转换成本」降了下来。

examples.zh: 轮渡业务的「商业利润」为博物馆新翼提供资金。

examples.en: After tax, commercial profit rose nine percent on flat revenue.
examples.zh: 收入持平的情况下，税后「商业利润」仍增长了百分之九。

words.enDefinition: a procurement for commercial

examples.en: All commercial procurement now runs through one competitive e-tender platform.
examples.zh: 「商业采购」如今全部走统一的竞标平台。

examples.en: Her small team handles commercial procurement for all twelve sites.
examples.zh: 她的团队负责十二个场所的「商业采购」。

words.enDefinition: a register of commercial

examples.zh: 汇出任何押金之前，先查「商业登记簿」。

examples.en: The new office appears on the commercial register from Monday.
examples.zh: 这家新办事处自周一起登入「商业注册」名录。

words.enDefinition: a process used for commercial scales

examples.zh: 我们的「商业服务」台一小时内答复供应商的询问。

examples.en: Cleaning, security, and maintenance all fall under commercial service contracts.
examples.zh: 清洁和保养属于「商业服务」合同的范畴。

examples.zh: 超过一万元的「商业交易」都需要双人签批。

examples.zh: 法院认定这宗以货易货属于「商业交易」。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from matching cost with

examples.zh: 讲「收入费用配比」的教科书章节用的是航运案例。

examples.zh: 经济学家把「边际收入产量」与加班溢价进行权衡。

words.enDefinition: quality measures for marketable

examples.en: Only grain of marketable quality may enter the state reserve bid.
examples.zh: 只有达到「适合销售的质量」的谷物才能参与国储竞标。

examples.en: Cooling the fruit fast keeps it at marketable quality for weeks.
examples.zh: 快速给水果降温能使其「适销品质」保持数周。

words.enDefinition: dividing a market into distinct buyer groups so offers can be targeted

examples.en: Market segmentation put fleet buyers and families into separate campaigns.
examples.zh: 「市场细分」把车队买家和家庭用户分进了不同的营销活动。

examples.en: Our market segmentation rests on usage, not just income bands.
examples.zh: 我们的「市场细分」依据使用场景，而不仅是收入档次。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from market

examples.en: Market turnover thinned out noticeably as the long holiday approached.
examples.zh: 临近假期，「市场成交额」明显萎缩。

examples.en: Exchange data showed market turnover doubling within a single month.
examples.zh: 交易所数据显示「市场周转额」一个月内翻倍。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning market

examples.en: Busy Saturday morning market trade keeps the village bakery alive.
examples.zh: 周六的「集市贸易」养活着村里的面包坊。

examples.en: Council surveyors track market trade stall by stall each quarter.
examples.zh: 镇政府的统计按摊位逐个记录「市场交易」。

words.enDefinition: management of marketing

examples.en: Good marketing management shifted budget from print to search ads.
examples.zh: 高明的「销售管理」把预算从平面广告转向了搜索广告。

examples.en: She teaches marketing management to evening business students downtown twice weekly.
examples.zh: 她在市中心的夜校讲授「营销管理」。

words.enDefinition: a manager responsible for marketing

examples.en: Our marketing manager tests every claim against the data first.
examples.zh: 我们的「销售经理」每句宣传语都要先过数据这一关。

examples.en: Our marketing manager vetoed the celebrity endorsement deal as off-brand.
examples.zh: 「营销经理」否决了那笔与品牌形象不符的名人合作。

words.enDefinition: policies governing prices used in marketing

examples.en: Group marketing price policies forbid discounts steeper than fifteen percent.
examples.zh: 「销售价格政策」禁止低于八五折的折扣。

examples.en: Seasonal marketing price policies keep the resale margins predictable for retailers.
examples.zh: 季节性的「价格政策」让转售毛利可以预期。

words.enDefinition: a mutual arrangement concerning marketing

examples.en: The two breweries signed a marketing agreement for shared shelf space.
examples.zh: 两家啤酒厂签订了共享货架的「市场销售协议」。

examples.en: The three-year marketing agreement bars us from the northern provinces.
examples.zh: 这份「销售协议」禁止我们进入北方各省。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage marketing cost

examples.en: Marketing cost control means every campaign carries a CPA cap.
examples.zh: 「销售成本控制」要求每个营销活动都设定获客成本上限。

examples.en: Tighter marketing cost control freed funds for proper product testing.
examples.zh: 收紧「营销成本管控」为产品测试腾出了资金。

words.zhGloss: 市场营销决策支持系统
words.enDefinition: a system for marketing decision supporting
acceptedZhAnswers: 市场营销决策支持系统

examples.en: The marketing decision supporting system flags campaigns with rising CPAs.
examples.zh: 「市场营销决策支持系统」会标记获客成本攀升的活动。

examples.en: Retailers feed till data into the marketing decision supporting system.
examples.zh: 零售商把收银数据接入「营销决策支持系统」。

collocations: test the marketing decision supporting system
refine the marketing decision supporting system
compare the marketing decision supporting system

words.zhGloss: 以供应市场为目的的果菜园
words.enDefinition: a garden grown to supply produce to market
acceptedZhAnswers: 以供应市场为目的的果菜园

examples.en: Their little market garden supplies salad leaves to city restaurants.
examples.zh: 他们的「商品菜园」向城市餐馆供应沙拉叶菜。

examples.en: Grandfather turned the orchard into a market garden after the war.
examples.zh: 战后，祖父把果园改成了「供应市场的果菜园」。

collocations: clear goods through the market garden

words.enDefinition: margin (collateral) required or adjusted for market difference trading positions

examples.en: Traders post a market difference margin when spread positions widen.
examples.zh: 价差头寸扩大时，交易者须补缴「市场价差保证金」。

examples.en: Clearing rules adjust the market difference margin every single day.
examples.zh: 结算规则每日调整「市场价差保证金」。

words.enDefinition: forecasting for market and sales

examples.en: Market and sales forecasting drives our hiring plan each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天的招聘计划都以「市场与销售预测」为依据。

examples.en: Poor market and sales forecasting left the plant half idle.
examples.zh: 「市场与销售预测」失误，使工厂闲置了一半产能。

collocations: prioritise the market and sales forecasting
standardise the market and sales forecasting
monitor the market and sales forecasting

words.enDefinition: clearing of market

examples.en: Prices adjust continuously until market clearing finally balances every order.
examples.zh: 价格不断调整，直到「市场结算」使所有订单达到平衡。

examples.en: Auction rules guarantee full market clearing at the closing bell.
examples.zh: 拍卖规则保证收盘钟响时完成「市场出清」。

words.enDefinition: a place or arena where goods are bought and sold

examples.en: Online platforms became the market place for used machine tools.
examples.zh: 线上平台成了二手机床的「交易市场」。

examples.en: Vendors pack the crowded market place before dawn every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每周六天亮前，摊贩就挤满了「市场」。

collocations: clear goods through the market place

words.enDefinition: prices charged in market transactions

examples.en: Contract delivery bonuses flex freely with market prices for nickel.
examples.zh: 合同奖金随镍的「市价」浮动。

examples.en: Farmers compare market prices at two co-ops before selling anything.
examples.zh: 农户出售前会比较两家合作社的「市价」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of market replacement

examples.en: Insurers settle these claims at market replacement cost, minus wear.
examples.zh: 保险公司按「市场重置成本」理赔，再扣除折旧。

examples.en: Auditors test inventory at market replacement cost each year end.
examples.zh: 审计师在每年年末按「市场重置成本」检验存货计价。

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in market

examples.en: The old market house collects stall fees every first Monday.
examples.zh: 「市场管理所」每月第一个周一收取摊位费。

examples.en: Renovations can begin once the market house grants the permit.
examples.zh: 「市场管理所」批准许可后，翻新工程即可开工。

words.enDefinition: mechanisms by which markets allocate resources and set prices

examples.en: New carbon market mechanisms reward factories that cut emissions fastest.
examples.zh: 碳「市场机制」奖励减排最快的工厂。

examples.en: Understanding basic market mechanisms helps farmers time their sales better.
examples.zh: 理解「市场机制」有助于农户把握销售时机。

words.enDefinition: the cost of complete manufacturing

examples.en: Quotes must reflect the complete manufacturing cost, with freight included.
examples.zh: 报价必须反映「全部制造成本」，含运费。

examples.en: Our complete manufacturing cost per chair fell below forty dollars.
examples.zh: 我们每把椅子的「全部制造成本」降到了四十美元以下。

words.enDefinition: quality measures for low

examples.en: Buyers returned the whole shipment, citing the low quality stitching.
examples.zh: 买方以「低质量」的缝线为由退回了货物。

examples.en: Chasing low quality inputs eventually cost us two key accounts.
examples.zh: 贪图「低质量」的原料让我们丢了两个大客户。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in loco transactions

examples.en: We quote a loco price at the mine gate, haulage extra.
examples.zh: 我们按矿区门口的「当地交货价格」报价，运费另计。

examples.en: Under a loco price, buyers arrange all their own trucks.
examples.zh: 按「当地交货价」成交时，买方自行安排车辆。

words.enDefinition: a market for local wholesale

examples.en: Traders drive the night catch straight to the local wholesale market.
examples.zh: 商贩把夜间渔获直接运往「地方批发市场」。

examples.en: The local wholesale market sets prices for half the province.
examples.zh: 这个「地方批发市场」影响着半个省的行情。

words.enDefinition: a locally issued letter of credit used for domestic or onshore settlement

examples.en: A local credit from the city bank settles the domestic leg.
examples.zh: 城市银行开立的「本地信用证」结算境内环节。

examples.en: Suppliers much prefer a local credit to any post-dated cheques.
examples.zh: 供应商更愿意接受「本地信用证」，而不是远期支票。

words.enDefinition: a locally issued letter of credit used for domestic or onshore settlement

examples.en: Open a local letter of credit for the fabric supplier.
examples.zh: 给面料供应商开一张「本地信用证」。

examples.en: The local letter of credit expires on the thirtieth of June.
examples.zh: 这张「本地信用证」三十日到期。

collocations: arrange the local letter of credit
monitor the local letter of credit
repay the local letter of credit

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for main

examples.en: All departments submit draft figures before the main budget consolidates.
examples.zh: 各部门先交草案，再汇总进「总预算」。

examples.en: The main budget funds the clinic, not the car park.
examples.zh: 「总预算」拨款给诊所，而非停车场。

words.enDefinition: control of costs used in professional practice

examples.en: Control of costs starts with approving travel before anyone books.
examples.zh: 「成本控制」从订票前的出差审批做起。

examples.en: The turnaround plan credits its recovery to strict control of costs.
examples.zh: 扭亏计划把成效归功于严格的「成本管理」。

words.enDefinition: a make a market used in professional practice

examples.en: Two dealers make a market in the bond after hours.
examples.zh: 盘后有两家交易商为这种债券「做市」。

examples.en: Without someone willing to make a market, spreads widen fast.
examples.zh: 一旦没人愿意「做市」，价差就会迅速拉大。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning lump-sum

examples.en: The whole office fit-out went ahead under a lump-sum contract.
examples.zh: 装修工程按「总价合同」推进。

examples.en: A lump-sum contract shifts all overrun risk to the builder.
examples.zh: 「总价合同」把超支风险转给了承建方。

words.enDefinition: a tender for competitive

examples.en: The rail authority awards track work only by competitive tender.
examples.zh: 铁路部门只通过「竞争性投标」授予轨道工程。

examples.en: Our competitive tender came in second by a single point.
examples.zh: 我们的「竞标」以一分之差屈居第二。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for control of manufacturing

examples.en: Weekly tooling checks anchor our control of manufacturing expenses on site.
examples.zh: 每周的工装检查是「制造费用控制」的基础。

examples.en: Control of manufacturing expenses slipped badly during the rush orders.
examples.zh: 赶工期间，「制造费用控制」有所松懈。

collocations: book the control of manufacturing expenses
forecast the control of manufacturing expenses
limit the control of manufacturing expenses

words.enDefinition: control over purchases

examples.en: Dual sign-off tightened control of purchases across the five depots.
examples.zh: 双人签批收紧了五个仓库的「采购控制」。

examples.en: The fraud review found weak control of purchases in seasonal hiring.
examples.zh: 舞弊检查发现旺季雇用环节的「采购控制」较为薄弱。

words.enDefinition: to push market prices upward through bullish buying

examples.en: Traders pooled orders to bull the market ahead of the frost report.
examples.zh: 霜冻报告发布前，交易商集中买单「哄抬市场价格」。

examples.en: Regulators fined the syndicate that tried to bull the market.
examples.zh: 监管机构处罚了试图「哄抬市价」的团伙。

words.enDefinition: an attorney who handles customs matters

examples.en: Our customs attorney untangled the mislabelled cargo in two days.
examples.zh: 我们的「海关代理人」两天内理清了错误申报的货物。

examples.en: A good customs attorney knows the tariff schedule by heart.
examples.zh: 一位称职的「海关律师」对税则表烂熟于心。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in probable transactions

examples.en: The banker's letter gives a probable price, not a commitment.
examples.zh: 银行家的信函给出的是「大概的价格」，并非承诺。

examples.en: We budget using the probable price of freight for next year.
examples.zh: 我们按明年运费的「大概价格」编制预算。

words.enDefinition: the cost of probable

examples.en: Estimate the probable cost of downtime before signing the SLA.
examples.zh: 签订服务协议前，先估算停机的「大约成本」。

examples.en: Their probable cost estimate for relocation seemed far too optimistic.
examples.zh: 他们对搬迁的「大约成本」估计得过于乐观。

words.enDefinition: statements of production and cost

examples.en: Monthly production and cost statements reach the board by the fifth.
examples.zh: 每月的「生产和成本报表」五号前送达董事会。

examples.en: Compare the production and cost statements across both shifts carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细比较两个班次的「生产和成本报表」。

words.enDefinition: a department for production

examples.en: The production department blamed late drawings for the schedule slip.
examples.zh: 「生产部门」把进度延误归咎于图纸晚到。

examples.en: All requests route through the production department before purchase orders.
examples.zh: 请购单须先经「生产部门」再开采购订单。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for production department

examples.en: Overtime pay dominates the production department expense bill this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度「生产部门费用」以加班费为大头。

examples.en: Head office questioned the sudden jump in production department expense.
examples.zh: 总部质疑「生产部门费用」为何激增。

words.enDefinition: inputs used in production, such as labour and capital

examples.en: Land, labour, and capital remain the three classic production factors.
examples.zh: 土地、劳动和资本仍是经典的「生产要素」。

examples.en: Cheap energy changed the whole mix of production factors overnight.
examples.zh: 廉价的能源一夜之间改变了「生产要素」的组合。

words.enDefinition: a function for production

examples.en: The model's production function assumes constant returns to scale throughout.
examples.zh: 该模型的「生产函数」假设规模报酬不变。

examples.en: Automation has shifted our production function toward much greater capital intensity.
examples.zh: 自动化使我们的「生产函数」转向资本密集型。

words.enDefinition: products related to production

examples.en: Robots and presses are production goods, not ordinary office assets.
examples.zh: 机器人和压机属于「生产物品」，而非办公资产。

examples.en: The warehouse physically separates all production goods from resale stock.
examples.zh: 仓库把「生产物品」与转售存货分开存放。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for production

examples.en: Sales dips forced two separate revisions of the production budget.
examples.zh: 销售下滑迫使「生产预算」两度修订。

examples.en: The production budget assumes scrap rates stay under five percent.
examples.zh: 「生产预算」假设废品率保持在百分之五以下。

words.enDefinition: capacity for production

examples.en: The new kiln added a full third more production capacity.
examples.zh: 新窑炉使「生产能力」增加了三分之一。

examples.en: We rent extra production capacity only for the holiday peak.
examples.zh: 节日旺季我们租用额外的「生产能力」。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for production center

examples.en: Production center costing assigns power costs to each workshop separately.
examples.zh: 「生产中心成本计算」把电费分摊到各车间。

examples.en: We adopted production center costing right after the automation upgrade.
examples.zh: 自动化升级后，我们采用了「生产中心成本计算」。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with production

examples.en: The whole film is financed by a Belgian production company.
examples.zh: 这部影片由比利时一家「制片公司」投资。

examples.en: As a production company, we lease rather than buy rigs.
examples.zh: 作为「生产公司」，我们租赁钻机而不购买。

collocations: open an account at the production company

words.enDefinition: the cost of production

examples.en: Cheaper catalysts trimmed production cost per tonne by six dollars.
examples.zh: 更便宜的催化剂使每吨「生产成本」下降了六美元。

examples.en: Full production cost data backs every figure in our tender submission.
examples.zh: 完整的「生产成本」数据支撑着我们的投标文件。

words.enDefinition: a center for production cost

examples.en: Each press lines up as its own production cost center.
examples.zh: 每台压机都是一个独立的「生产成本中心」。

examples.en: Reports now charge downtime to the responsible production cost center.
examples.zh: 报表把停工损失记到责任「生产成本中心」。

collocations: brief the team on the production cost center

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for producer's

examples.en: The producer's price excludes transport, storage, and retail markups entirely.
examples.zh: 「生产者价格」不含运输、仓储和零售加价。

examples.en: Census statisticians publish the producer's price for each sector monthly.
examples.zh: 统计人员每月公布各行业的「生产者价格」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in producer transactions

examples.en: Wheat's producer price rose well ahead of the retail index.
examples.zh: 小麦的「生产者价格」先于零售指数上涨。

examples.en: A stable producer price keeps annual farm budgets predictable for families.
examples.zh: 稳定的「生产者价格」让农业预算可以预期。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for procurement

examples.en: Centralising our suppliers cut procurement costs by a full fifth.
examples.zh: 供应商集中化使「采购成本」下降了五分之一。

examples.en: Hidden procurement costs usually surface at customs, not in catalogs.
examples.zh: 隐藏的「采购成本」往往在海关环节才暴露。

words.enDefinition: the cost of producing

examples.en: Cheaper resins lowered the producing cost of every single moulding.
examples.zh: 更便宜的树脂降低了每件模塑品的「生产成本」。

examples.en: Compare producing cost between the two plants before allocating the order.
examples.zh: 分配订单之前，先比较各厂的「生产成本」。

words.enDefinition: cost centres that produce goods or services

examples.en: Assembly and plating operate as two separate producing cost centers.
examples.zh: 装配和电镀作为两个独立的「生产成本中心」运作。

examples.en: Managers benchmark all producing cost centers against last year's actuals.
examples.zh: 管理层以去年实际数为基准对比各「生产成本中心」。

words.enDefinition: theory of producing cost

examples.en: The lecture paired producing cost theory with real smelter data.
examples.zh: 这门课把「生产成本理论」与冶炼厂的真实数据结合起来。

examples.en: Producing cost theory explains exactly why high-cost mines close first.
examples.zh: 「生产成本理论」解释了为何高成本矿山先被关停。

words.enDefinition: the cost of producing department

examples.en: Maintenance hours feed the producing department cost allocation every month.
examples.zh: 维修工时计入「生产部门成本」的分摊。

examples.en: The controller trims producing department cost before pricing any renewals.
examples.zh: 续约定价之前，财务控制人先压缩「生产部门成本」。

words.enDefinition: a valuation ratio equal to market price per share divided by earnings per share

examples.en: A price-earnings ratio above thirty quickly made many investors nervous.
examples.zh: 三十倍的「价格-收益比率」让投资者感到不安。

examples.en: First compare this price-earnings ratio with the sector median value.
examples.zh: 先把这个「市盈率」与行业中位数比较一下。

words.enDefinition: control or dominance over pricing in a market

examples.en: The patent gives the lab real price sovereignty for two years.
examples.zh: 这项专利让实验室两年内拥有真正的「价格统治权」。

examples.en: Retail giants erode small brands' price sovereignty through rebate ladders.
examples.zh: 零售巨头用返利阶梯侵蚀小品牌的「价格支配权」。

words.enDefinition: the price offered in a tender

examples.en: The price tendered must stay valid for a full ninety days.
examples.zh: 「投标价格」必须在九十天内保持有效。

examples.en: Committee members compared each price tendered against the engineer's estimate.
examples.zh: 委员会成员把每个「投标价」与工程师估算进行对照。

words.enDefinition: a pricing out of market used in professional practice

examples.en: Hiking the subscription again risks pricing out of market entirely.
examples.zh: 再次上调订阅费有「定价过高而失去市场」的风险。

examples.en: Their gold trim option was pure pricing out of market thinking.
examples.zh: 他们那款镀金装饰纯属「定价过高，自绝于市场」。

collocations: clear goods through the pricing out of market
stock the pricing out of market
audit the pricing out of market

words.enDefinition: a prices at a discount used in professional practice

examples.en: The outlet clears last season's range at prices at a discount of forty percent.
examples.zh: 折扣店以四折的「折扣价格」清售上季商品。

examples.en: Members shop early to catch the prices at a discount.
examples.zh: 会员们早早购物，赶「打折价格」的头班车。

collocations: book the prices at a discount
forecast the prices at a discount
limit the prices at a discount

words.enDefinition: an import deposit that must be lodged before importation

examples.en: An prior import deposit of forty percent applies to luxury cars.
examples.zh: 进口豪车须预缴百分之四十的「预缴进口保证金」。

examples.en: Importers must fund the prior import deposit months before shipment.
examples.zh: 进口商要在装运前数月筹措「预缴进口保证金」。

words.enDefinition: a deposit paid by a customer for returnable containers

examples.en: The customer's container deposit refunds once the kegs return clean.
examples.zh: 客户交还干净酒桶后，退还「容器押金」。

examples.en: We track every customer's container deposit in the warehouse module.
examples.zh: 我们在仓库模块中逐笔记录「客户容器押金」。

words.enDefinition: rating for customer's credit

examples.en: The customer's credit rating slipped below investment grade in March.
examples.zh: 三月，这位客户的「信用评级」跌至投资级以下。

examples.en: Sales cannot extend terms without checking the customer's credit rating.
examples.zh: 未核查「客户信用等级」之前，销售不得放宽账期。

words.enDefinition: the cost of production index unit

examples.en: We track production index unit cost against last year's baseline.
examples.zh: 我们把「生产指数单位成本」与去年基线作对比跟踪。

examples.zh: 「生产指数单位成本」下降说明产线纪律改善。

allocate the production index unit cost
cut the production index unit cost

words.enDefinition: the cost of budgeted

examples.en: Actual spend exceeded budgeted cost on every event this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天每场活动的实际支出都超过了「预算成本」。

examples.en: Monthly variance reports compare budgeted cost with actuals by account.
examples.zh: 差异报告按科目比较「预算成本」与实际数。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in prohibitive transactions

examples.en: Spare turbines still carry a prohibitive price for small co-operatives.
examples.zh: 对小型合作社来说，备用涡轮机是「抑制购买的价格」。

examples.en: The prohibitive price of bilberries keeps the jam firmly artisanal.
examples.zh: 越橘「高得吓人的价格」让果酱保持了手工属性。

words.enDefinition: a prohibition of payment used in professional practice

examples.en: A court-ordered prohibition of payment froze the supplier's bank account.
examples.zh: 法院签发的「停止支付令」冻结了供应商账户。

examples.en: The prohibition of payment remains until the dispute hearing concludes.
examples.zh: 「止付令」将持续到纠纷开庭为止。

words.enDefinition: capacity for budgeted

examples.en: The plant ran above budgeted capacity through the whole quarter.
examples.zh: 整季度工厂的运行都超过了「预算生产能力」。

examples.en: Variance analysis blames idle weeks on budgeted capacity set too high.
examples.zh: 差异分析把闲置周归咎于「预算产能」定得过高。

words.enDefinition: management of project

examples.en: Good project management kept the whole refit inside eighty days.
examples.zh: 出色的「项目管理」使改装工期控制在八十天内。

examples.en: She personally runs project management for all the store rollouts.
examples.zh: 她负责所有门店开设的「项目管理」。

words.enDefinition: a line item in a budget

examples.en: Training vanished as a budget item after the June review.
examples.zh: 六月评审之后，培训从「预算项目」中消失了。

examples.en: Each budget item clearly names one owner and one deadline.
examples.zh: 每个「预算项目」都指定一名负责人和一个期限。

words.enDefinition: the layout or arrangement of a budget

examples.en: A much clearer budget layout cut board questions in half.
examples.zh: 更清晰的「预算编排」让董事会的质询少了一半。

examples.en: The template now fixes our budget layout for every application.
examples.zh: 模板统一了每次申报的「预算编排」格式。

words.enDefinition: management of budget

examples.en: Disciplined budget management carried the parish hall project through unscathed.
examples.zh: 严格的「预算管理」支撑着教区礼堂项目顺利完成。

examples.en: Budget management training also helps new foremen read the ledgers.
examples.zh: 「预算管理」培训帮助新工长看懂台账。

words.enDefinition: a manager responsible for budget

examples.en: Our budget manager personally challenges every invoice above two thousand.
examples.zh: 我们的「预算管理人员」对两千元以上的发票逐一质询。

examples.en: The budget manager reconciles all forecasts with actuals every month.
examples.zh: 「预算管理员」每月核对预测与实际数。

words.enDefinition: a requirement for budgetary

examples.en: Each budgetary requirement maps directly to a named strategic goal.
examples.zh: 每项「预算需要」都对应一项明确的战略目标。

examples.en: The ministry rejected the bid for lacking a budgetary requirement analysis.
examples.zh: 部委以缺少「预算需求分析」为由驳回了申请。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in budgetary transactions

examples.en: A budgetary price of four hundred anchors the tender maths.
examples.zh: 四百元的「预算价格」是投标测算的基准。

examples.en: Suppliers must hold the budgetary price for two full quarters.
examples.zh: 供应商必须在两个季度内维持「预算价格」。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from productive

examples.en: The workshop's productive profit alone funds its entire apprenticeship scheme.
examples.zh: 作坊的「生产利润」为学徒计划提供资金。

examples.en: Economists carefully separate genuine productive profit from mere speculative windfalls.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「生产性利润」与投机暴利区分开。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from productivity differential

examples.en: Automation created a lasting productivity differential profit over slower rivals.
examples.zh: 自动化带来了领先慢对手的「生产率差别利润」。

examples.en: Their productivity differential profit shrank quickly once the patents expired.
examples.zh: 专利到期后，他们的「生产率差别利润」缩水了。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in recoverable amount related to productivity

examples.en: Silo dust quietly accelerated productivity impairment across the whole plant.
examples.zh: 筒仓粉尘加速了全厂的「生产能力下降」。

examples.en: The annual report flags productivity impairment on the older kilns.
examples.zh: 年报对老旧窑炉的「产能受损」作了标注。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for bulk-line

examples.en: Bulk-line costs drop once the third kiln runs full time.
examples.zh: 第三座窑炉满负荷运转后，「大宗生产成本」随之下降。

examples.en: Analysts benchmark bulk-line costs against every rival across the industry.
examples.zh: 分析师对全行业的「大宗生产成本」进行对标。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning bulk sales

examples.en: The mill signed a bulk sales contract covering twelve months.
examples.zh: 面粉厂签订了一份为期十二个月的「大宗销售合同」。

examples.en: Price reopeners sit in every bulk sales contract we sign.
examples.zh: 我们签订的每份「大宗销售合同」都含价格重开条款。

words.enDefinition: a quota for production

examples.en: The cooperative allocates each member farm its annual production quota.
examples.zh: 合作社向每个农场分配年度「生产配额」。

examples.en: Exceeding the production quota triggers a levy on surplus litres.
examples.zh: 超出「生产限额」的部分按升加征税费。

words.enDefinition: a process used for production

examples.en: The new production process neatly halves the resin curing time.
examples.zh: 新的「生产过程」把固化时间缩短了一半。

examples.en: Document every production process change before the ISO audit begins.
examples.zh: ISO审核之前，把每处「生产流程」变更记录在案。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in production transactions

examples.en: Subsidies hold the production price near cost for staple grains.
examples.zh: 补贴使主食的「生产价格」接近成本水平。

examples.en: Falling crude prices dragged the production price of fertilisers down.
examples.zh: 原油下跌拖低了化肥的「生产价格」。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to production

examples.en: Foreman salaries fall under production overheads, not under direct labour.
examples.zh: 领班的工资归入「生产间接费用」，而非直接人工。

examples.en: Absorbing production overheads fairly remains this audit's biggest sticking point.
examples.zh: 公平分配「生产间接费用」是本次审计的争议点。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling productive labor cost

examples.en: The team settled on the productive labor cost method for overheads.
examples.zh: 团队决定用「生产人工成本法」分配间接费用。

examples.en: Under the productive labor cost method, machine-heavy lines look cheaper.
examples.zh: 按「生产人工成本法」，机器密集的生产线显得更省。

collocations: test the productive labor cost method
refine the productive labor cost method
compare the productive labor cost method

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with production-oriented

examples.en: As a production-oriented company, we still measure everything in tonnes.
examples.zh: 作为「生产导向型公司」，我们以吨为单位衡量一切。

examples.en: The production-oriented company simply ignored the drift in consumer taste.
examples.zh: 这家「由生产决定的公司」忽视了消费者口味的转变。

words.enDefinition: a curve showing maximum output combinations attainable with given resources and technology

examples.en: Grain-for-oil trade-offs sit right on the national economy's production-possibility frontier.
examples.zh: 粮换油的取舍落在经济的「生产可能边界线」上。

examples.en: Better machinery shifts the whole production-possibility frontier outward for everyone.
examples.zh: 更先进的机械使「生产可能性边界」向外移动。

words.enDefinition: the cost of productive capacity

examples.en: Idle months still carry productive capacity cost through the lease.
examples.zh: 即便停产数月，「生产能量成本」仍随租约照常发生。

examples.en: Managers weigh productive capacity cost against every single expansion plan.
examples.zh: 管理层用「生产能量成本」衡量每个扩建方案。

words.enDefinition: a profits prior to incorporation used in professional practice

examples.en: Lawyers must ring-fence profits prior to incorporation for the founders.
examples.zh: 律师必须把「组成公司前利润」单独划归创始人。

examples.en: Profits prior to incorporation belong to the partners, not the company.
examples.zh: 「公司成立前的利润」归合伙人，而非公司。

collocations: calculate the profits prior to incorporation
compare the profits prior to incorporation
interpret the profits prior to incorporation

words.enDefinition: a profits prior to consolidation used in professional practice

examples.en: The merger agreement reserves profits prior to consolidation for shareholders.
examples.zh: 合并协议把「联合(合并)前利润」预留给了股东。

examples.en: Auditors carefully separated the profits prior to consolidation from goodwill.
examples.zh: 审计人员把「合并前利润」与商誉分开核算。

words.enDefinition: taking of profit

examples.en: Profit taking trimmed the morning rally down within an hour.
examples.zh: 「获利了结」在一小时内让涨势回软。

examples.en: Sellers chose profit taking rather than waiting for the report.
examples.zh: 卖家选择「获利了结」，而不是等待数据发布。

words.enDefinition: a targeted level of profit

examples.en: Each quarter the team defends its profit target in review.
examples.zh: 每季度团队都要在评审会上为「利润目标」答辩。

examples.en: Missing the profit target twice in a row triggers a strategy reset.
examples.zh: 两次未达「利润目标」就会触发战略复盘。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for program

examples.en: The literacy program budget covers books, tutors, and bus transport.
examples.zh: 扫盲「项目预算」涵盖书本、师资和交通车。

examples.en: Donors review the program budget line by line each May.
examples.zh: 捐赠人每年五月逐行审查「项目预算」。

words.enDefinition: budgeting for program

examples.en: Program budgeting ties every single dollar to a measurable outcome.
examples.zh: 「计划预算」把每一元都与可衡量的成果挂钩。

examples.en: The agency switched entirely to program budgeting five years ago.
examples.zh: 该机构五年前改用了「项目预算编制」。

words.enDefinition: measurement of profit

examples.en: Profit measurement changes completely once you capitalise your development spend.
examples.zh: 一旦资本化开发支出，「利润计量」的结果就不同了。

examples.en: The seminar compares profit measurement rules across IFRS and GAAP.
examples.zh: 研讨班比较IFRS与GAAP下的「利润计量」。

words.enDefinition: the goal or process of earning the greatest possible profit

examples.en: Profit maximization alone pushed the airline to overbook its flights aggressively.
examples.zh: 仅仅追求「利润最大化」，就促使这家航空公司激进超售。

examples.en: Economists try to model the exact output where profit maximization occurs.
examples.zh: 经济学家对「利润最大化」时的产出水平建模。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of profit

examples.en: Reinsurers pay a profit commission when loss ratios run low.
examples.zh: 赔付率较低时，再保险人支付「利润佣金」。

examples.zh: 「利润佣金」按经审计的结果每年结算一次。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage profit

examples.en: Weekly margin calls give the branch very tight profit control.
examples.zh: 每周的毛利例会使分店实现严格的「利润管理」。

examples.en: Profit control failed badly when discounts bypassed the approval chain.
examples.zh: 折扣绕过审批链条后，「利润管控」形同虚设。

words.enDefinition: profit earned during a stated accounting term or period

examples.en: Profit for the term came in eight percent above plan.
examples.zh: 「本期利润」比计划高出百分之八。

examples.en: The interim accounts show profit for the term after tax.
examples.zh: 中期报表列示了税后的「本期利润」。

words.enDefinition: profit obtained from amalgamation

examples.en: Creditors shared the profit from amalgamation after the merger closed.
examples.zh: 合并完成后，债权人分享了「合并利润」。

examples.en: Official statisticians always exclude profit from amalgamation when comparing years.
examples.zh: 统计人员在跨年度比较时剔除「合并产生的利润」。

words.enDefinition: a paper concerning profit on

examples.en: The deal shows profit on paper until the receivable ages.
examples.zh: 在应收账款变老之前，这笔交易只是「纸上利润」。

examples.en: Beware of profit on paper built entirely from revaluation gains.
examples.zh: 警惕由重估收益堆出来的「账面利润」。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to profit on

examples.en: Profit on sales of refits beats new builds this year.
examples.zh: 今年改装业务的「销售利润」超过了新造船。

examples.en: The franchise reports profit on sales weekly rather than monthly.
examples.zh: 这家特许经营商按周而非按月上报「销售利润」。

words.enDefinition: sharing of profit

examples.en: Profit sharing pays each crew member a slice of the voyage.
examples.zh: 「分红制」让每位船员分得航次的收益。

examples.en: The union traded wage rises for a profit sharing plan.
examples.zh: 工会用加薪换取了一项「利润分享计划」。

words.enDefinition: a buyer for foreign retailer

examples.zh: 「外国零售商采购人」每年春天到访我们的纺织厂。

examples.en: One buyer of foreign retailer groups placed the whole linen order.
examples.zh: 一位「外国零售集团采购人」包下了整单亚麻面料。

collocations: prioritise the buyer of foreign retailer
standardise the buyer of foreign retailer
monitor the buyer of foreign retailer

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for buying market

examples.zh: 交易商全天在屏幕上报出「买入时的市场价格」。

examples.en: Always compare the buying market price with your bank's quote.
examples.zh: 把「买入时的市场价格」与银行报价比较一下。

words.enDefinition: a postponement of payment used in professional practice

examples.en: The landlord granted a formal postponement of payment until March.
examples.zh: 房东同意「付款延期」到三月份。

examples.en: Request a formal postponement of payment before the penalty starts.
examples.zh: 在罚则启动前，先申请正式的「付款延期」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of current

examples.en: Restating land at current cost changed the balance sheet picture.
examples.zh: 按「现行成本」重估土地改变了资产负债表的样貌。

examples.en: Sound replacement decisions use current cost figures, not historic invoices.
examples.zh: 更新决策要用「现行成本」，而不是历史发票价。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with business

examples.en: Any business company in the zone may join the cluster.
examples.zh: 区内任何「商业公司」都可以加入产业集群。

examples.en: She registered the business company quietly under her mother's name.
examples.zh: 她以母亲的名义注册了这家「商业公司」。

collocations: open an account at the business company

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for business

examples.en: The business budget survived the rent rise without any cuts.
examples.zh: 租金上涨后，「企业预算」没有削减就挺了过来。

examples.en: The two founders rebuild the business budget every quarter from scratch.
examples.zh: 创始人们每季度从头重编「企业预算」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of current outlay

examples.zh: 燃油是我们每月最大的「本期支出成本」。

examples.en: Compare the current outlay cost before choosing leasing versus buying.
examples.zh: 比较一下租车与购车各自的「当期支出成本」。

words.enDefinition: the failure or collapse of a business

examples.en: Late payments from one client caused the whole business failure.
examples.zh: 单个客户的拖欠导致了整个「企业倒闭」。

examples.en: Insolvency surveys rank cash flow as the top cause of business failure.
examples.zh: 破产调查显示，现金流是企业「倒闭」的首要原因。

words.enDefinition: the cost of preparatory

examples.en: Site clearing was a preparatory cost before any build began.
examples.zh: 场地清理是开工前的「准备成本」。

examples.en: Fund preparatory cost from the contingency, not the main budget.
examples.zh: 「准备成本」从应急金中列支，不动主预算。

words.enDefinition: a quotation for current

examples.en: Please send us the current quotation before Friday's purchasing call.
examples.zh: 周五采购例会之前，请发来「最新的报价」。

examples.en: Our current quotation holds completely firm for thirty days only.
examples.zh: 我们的「最新报价」仅维持三十天有效。

words.enDefinition: the price at the place of purchase

examples.en: We finally agreed a price loco at the mill gate.
examples.zh: 双方议定了磨坊门口的「购买地点价格」。

examples.en: Under price loco terms, all haulage stays with the buyer.
examples.zh: 按「购货地价格」条款，运输由买方承担。

words.enDefinition: a situation where one firm sets prices others follow

examples.zh: 市场老大行使「领导价格」，左右着所有人的毛利。

examples.en: Price leadership broke down quickly when the discount chain entered.
examples.zh: 折扣连锁进场后，「价格领导」格局瓦解了。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of price including

examples.en: Our agents quote a price including commission of five percent.
examples.zh: 代理商报出含百分之五佣金的「连佣金价格」。

examples.en: Even the price including commission still beats the rival bid.
examples.zh: 即便「连佣金价格」也低于竞争对手的报价。

words.enDefinition: a discrimination for price

examples.en: Regulators sued the airline over price discrimination by booking channel.
examples.zh: 监管机构就该航空公司按订票渠道实行「价格差别」提起诉讼。

examples.en: Student fares are legal price discrimination, carefully fenced by rules.
examples.zh: 学生票价属于合法的「价格歧视」，且有严格边界。

words.enDefinition: fluctuation in price

examples.en: Weekly price fluctuation makes fixed quotes genuinely risky for brokers.
examples.zh: 每周的「价格起伏」让固定报价对经纪商构成风险。

examples.zh: 套期保值平抑了合同年度内的「价格波动」。

words.enDefinition: resistance of prices to change

examples.en: The cost of menu printing explains some price rigidity in restaurants.
examples.zh: 菜谱印制成本部分解释了餐馆的「价格固定性」。

examples.en: Price rigidity often hides quiet quality cuts during high inflation.
examples.zh: 通胀期「价格刚性」的背后是悄悄的缩水降质。

words.enDefinition: a market for price

examples.en: Daily commuters have made the line a pure price market.
examples.zh: 通勤客群让这条线路成为纯粹的「注重价格的市场」。

examples.en: In a pure price market, even service extras rarely sell.
examples.zh: 在「价格导向市场」里，增值服务很难卖动。

words.enDefinition: a price level that is moderate or restrained rather than high or low

examples.en: We kept the price moderate to win first-time buyers over.
examples.zh: 我们把「价格」保持适中，以争取首次购买的顾客。

examples.en: Reviews praise the range for keeping the price moderate throughout.
examples.zh: 评测称赞该系列价格始终「适中」。

words.enDefinition: a price that is not competitive in the market

examples.zh: 加上运费后，采购团队认为该「价格」不具竞争力。

examples.zh: 零售商认为这份报价与本地品牌相比「价格缺乏竞争力」。

words.enDefinition: the price for goods delivered alongside the vessel

examples.zh: 双方按锚地「船边交货价格」成交。

examples.en: The seller's price delivered along vessel excludes all lighterage charges.
examples.zh: 卖方的「船边交货价格」不含驳运费。

collocations: need to price delivered along vessel
how to price delivered along vessel
fail to price delivered along vessel

words.enDefinition: reply cards prepaid for business responses

examples.zh: 目录中的「广告回信」使我们的线索翻倍。

examples.en: Postage on business reply cards is covered by the permit.
examples.zh: 「商业回邮卡」的邮资由许可账户支付。

words.enDefinition: the sector of business

examples.zh: 私营「企业部门」贡献了大部分新增岗位。

examples.en: Lending to the wider business sector tightened again this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度对「企业部门」的信贷再度收紧。

words.enDefinition: a market for heavy

examples.en: Dealers call it a heavy market when offers pile unsold.
examples.zh: 卖单堆积无人承接时，交易商称之为「不活跃的市场」。

examples.en: In a heavy market, sellers queue up and buyers wait.
examples.zh: 「不活跃的市场」里，卖家排队，买家观望。

words.enDefinition: profits arising from preacquisition

examples.en: The sale agreement hands preacquisition profits straight to the seller.
examples.zh: 出售协议把「预先取得利润」直接划归卖方。

examples.en: Auditors strip preacquisition profits out of the first consolidated year.
examples.zh: 审计人员把「购并前利润」从合并首年中剔除。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for prematurity

examples.en: A prematurity payment triggers a penalty under the loan terms.
examples.zh: 「未到期付款」会触发贷款条款下的罚则。

examples.en: The clerk flagged the prematurity payment before releasing any funds.
examples.zh: 出纳在放款前拦下了这笔「未到期付款」。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to preferred stockholders'

examples.zh: 市长的「成本效益理念」保住了老图书馆。

examples.zh: 这十年间，每个桥梁项目之前都做过「成本-收益研究」。

examples.zh: 一次「成本-收益评估」保住了夜班公交线。

examples.zh: 超过二百万元的项目须做「成本效益评估」。

examples.zh: 第一笔交易结算前须缴纳「原始保证金」。

examples.zh: 交易所再次上调了橡胶期货的「初始保证金」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of out-of-pocket manufacturing

examples.zh: 紧急报价只计算「付现制造成本」。

examples.zh: 「付现制造成本」在设计上不含折旧。

words.enDefinition: the cost of out-of-pocket

examples.zh: 仅凭票据按「付现成本」受理索赔。

examples.en: Volunteering locally keeps the whole out-of-pocket cost very near zero.
examples.zh: 志愿参与可以把「自付成本」降到几乎为零。

words.enDefinition: the cost of outlay

examples.en: The outlay cost for the kiln upgrade totals nine hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 窑炉改造的「支出成本」合计九十万元。

examples.zh: 批准之前，比较「支出成本」与全周期节约。

words.enDefinition: the cost of output

examples.zh: 预热器改造后，每吨「产出成本」下降了。

examples.zh: 标书要求报「产出成本」，而非目录价。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to other manufacturing

examples.zh: 小型工具和耗材归入「其他制造费用」。

examples.zh: 审计人员抽查「其他制造费用」，寻找缺失发票。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for other income

examples.zh: 「其他收益预算」计入了礼堂出租和摊位费。

examples.en: Other income budget shortfalls mostly come from empty market stalls.
examples.zh: 摊位空置使「其他收益预算」出现缺口。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for other

examples.zh: 小型工程列入「其他预算」，而非资本项。

examples.zh: 「其他预算」用于支付实习生津贴。

words.enDefinition: the cost incurred to manufacture a product

examples.zh: 一把椅子的「制造成本」降到了四十美元以下。

examples.en: Compare the cost to manufacture across both of our factories.
examples.zh: 比较两家工厂各自的「制造成本」。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit opened by an importer’s bank to pay for imported goods

examples.zh: 这份「进口信用证」要求三种检验证书。

examples.zh: 米兰的「进口保理商」替我们收取应收账款。

examples.zh: 「进口代理商」按发票金额预付八成。

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in import commission

examples.en: An import commission house in Lagos handles all our clearances.
examples.zh: 拉各斯的一家「进口代理商」负责我们的清关。

examples.en: The import commission house takes five percent on each lot.
examples.zh: 这家「进口佣金行」每批货抽五个点。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage import

examples.en: Import control tightened considerably on used electronics imports last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，二手电子产品的「进口管制」收紧了。

examples.en: Our compliance team tracks every single import control policy change.
examples.zh: 合规团队跟踪每一项「进口管制」的变动。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit opened by an importer’s bank to pay for imported goods

examples.zh: 这份「进口信用状」覆盖整批机械设备。

examples.en: Please ask the bank to confirm the import credit today.
examples.zh: 今天就让银行保兑这份「进口信用证」。

words.enDefinition: a curtailment for import

examples.en: Import curtailment on grain began immediately after the poor harvest.
examples.zh: 歉收之后，谷物「缩减进口」政策启动。

examples.en: The trade ministry announced an import curtailment on luxury goods.
examples.zh: 部委宣布对奢侈品「缩减进口」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in import transactions

examples.en: The import price of steel fell below domestic mill quotes.
examples.zh: 钢材「进口价格」跌到了国内钢厂报价之下。

examples.en: Customs value the goods at the import price plus freight.
examples.zh: 海关按「进口价格」加运费对货物估值。

words.enDefinition: a wholesaler of import

examples.en: An import wholesaler in Hamburg stocks all our spare parts.
examples.zh: 汉堡的一家「进口批发商」备有我们的配件库存。

examples.en: The import wholesaler breaks down full containers into smaller lots.
examples.zh: 这家「进口批发商」把整柜货拆分成小批。

words.enDefinition: a substitution for import

examples.en: Import substitution policies originally built up the local valve industry.
examples.zh: 「代替进口」政策催生了本地阀门产业。

examples.en: Import substitution works quite well until local component quality lags.
examples.zh: 「进口替代」在零部件质量掉队之前都是有效的。

words.enDefinition: a tender for import

examples.en: The port authority floated an import tender for new cranes.
examples.zh: 港务局为起重机发布了「进口招标」。

examples.en: Our import tender submission needs two solid local bank references.
examples.zh: 我们的「进口投标」需要两家本地客户的资历证明。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning import

examples.en: The import trade in timber revived after the tariffs eased.
examples.zh: 关税放宽后，木材「进口贸易」复苏了。

examples.en: Family-run firms have always dominated the import trade at this port.
examples.zh: 在这个港口，「进口贸易」由家族企业主导。

words.enDefinition: a bill of exchange arising from an import trade transaction

examples.en: The bank discounted the import trade bill immediately on presentation.
examples.zh: 银行在提示即日贴现了「进口贸易票据」。

examples.en: Each import trade bill references its own underlying purchase contract.
examples.zh: 每张「进口贸易票据」都注明对应的购货合同。

words.enDefinition: a market for parallel

examples.en: Fresh sanctions pushed more currency dealing onto the parallel market.
examples.zh: 制裁把货币交易挤到了「平行市场」。

examples.en: Goods reach shelves through the parallel market at premium prices.
examples.zh: 商品经由「平行市场」以溢价上架。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in import and export

examples.en: The provincial import and export corporation handles all our filings.
examples.zh: 省「进出口公司」负责办理我们的申报。

examples.en: As an import and export corporation, we hold both licences.
examples.zh: 作为「进出口公司」，我们同时持有两类许可证。

collocations: calculate the import and export corporation
compare the import and export corporation
interpret the import and export corporation

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for import

examples.en: Our import agent in Durban clears shipments within two days.
examples.zh: 德班的「进口代理商」两天内即可完成清关。

examples.en: A truly reliable import agent knows every single tariff pitfall.
examples.zh: 可靠的「进口代理」熟知关税上的各种坑。

words.enDefinition: a market for paper

examples.zh: 交易商以「纸货市场」对冲实货。

examples.en: Prices on the paper market lead the physical barrels by days.
examples.zh: 「纸(合同)市场」的价格领先实体油槽数天。

words.enDefinition: an improvement trade for import used in professional practice

examples.en: Fabric arrives completely duty-free under the improvement trade for import.
examples.zh: 面料按「加工进口贸易」免税入境。

examples.en: The improvement trade for import requires re-export within a year.
examples.zh: 「加工进口贸易」要求一年内复出口。

collocations: prioritise the improvement trade for import

monitor the improvement trade for import

words.enDefinition: an improvement trade for export used in professional practice

examples.zh: 我们的工厂靠「加工出口贸易」兴旺起来。

examples.en: Under the improvement trade for export, imported parts stay bonded.
examples.zh: 在「加工出口贸易」下，进口部件存于保税库。

collocations: prioritise the improvement trade for export
standardise the improvement trade for export

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for overhead standard

examples.en: Variances against overhead standard costs feed the monthly plant report.
examples.zh: 与「间接费用标准成本」的差异按月汇入工厂报表。

words.enDefinition: a wholesaler of importing

examples.zh: 悉尼的一家「进口批发商」备有我们全系列的配件。

examples.en: The importing wholesaler handles customs so retailers never touch forms.
examples.zh: 「进口批发商」包办清关，零售商完全不必碰单证。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to owner's

examples.en: Drawings above ten percent of owner's equity need a resolution.
examples.zh: 提款超过「业主权益」的百分之十，须通过决议。

examples.en: The balance sheet shows owner's equity built from retained profits.
examples.zh: 资产负债表显示「业主权益」由留存利润累积而成。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for imposed

examples.zh: 总部未经协商，就给各大区下达了「派定预算」。

examples.en: Staff quietly ignored an imposed budget they never helped shape.
examples.zh: 员工对这份从未参与制定的「派定预算」置之不理。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in package transactions

examples.zh: 旅行社报出的「组合价格」涵盖了机票和酒店。

examples.zh: 比起十项分列报价，买方更喜欢一个「打包价格」。

words.enDefinition: a market for improved

examples.zh: 降息为首次购房者带来了「好转的市场」。

examples.zh: 这笔交易以「补偿贸易」成交：用木材换涡轮机。

examples.zh: 「对销贸易」帮助双方避开了硬通货短缺。

examples.zh: 传阅合同档案前，先附上「成本明细表」。

examples.zh: 略低于十元的「魅力价格」带动了冲动消费。

examples.zh: 燃油按各加油站公示的「官方价格」出售。

examples.zh: 「分批成本制度」会标记超出预估的订单。

examples.zh: 合作社的「收益分配」向活跃社员倾斜。

examples.zh: 停车费只是展览馆的「杂项营业收入」。

examples.zh: 废料销售的「杂项收入」抵消了水电开支。

words.enDefinition: a paper concerning open market
